title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is a linear classifier. It tries to find a linear boundary between classes. Consider whether a linear boundary can separate the orange and blue points in the image.

title: Analyzing the Data Distribution
text: Look at the distribution of the orange and blue points. Do they form a pattern that can be separated by a straight line?

title: Boundary D Characteristics
text: Consider what kind of boundary would be needed to separate the two classes in the image. Is it linear or non-linear?
